name: Production Distro RC8
source: RC7 final audit; TASK.md; maestro-managed continuation
goal: Replace RC7 projections with real installable payload byte evidence, public signature artifact ingestion, installer VM smoke, exact-approved canary activation smoke, and rollback drill execution or denial through AgentCore and SecurityExecutionEngine gates.
core_thesis: AIOS becomes Ubuntu-like only when a user can fetch metadata from a mirror, verify immutable payload bytes and public signature artifacts locally, run installer preflight in a VM, and move to activation or rollback only through exact approval, AgentCore PlanSpec, and SecurityExecutionEngine.
non_goals: Do not claim GA production readiness.
Do not read, copy, print, hash, move, or reference private signing material.
Do not turn the mirror host into large object storage or a signing authority.
Do not install, activate, rollback, mutate boot metadata, mutate active slots, mutate production rings, upload support bundles, or enable remote fleet dispatch from contract work.
Do not treat payload byte reachability, object storage reachability, signature reachability, or frontend display as sufficient trust.
primary_acceptance: The RC8 contract defines real payload byte boundaries, immutable object descriptor requirements, public signature ingestion boundaries, installer VM smoke, and controlled execution gates.
Payload byte handling is quarantined until schema, size, digest, manifest, signature, revocation, compatibility, rollback baseline, and freshness verify.
The signer boundary returns only public signature artifacts; private key operations remain outside the repo, mirror, installer, workflow evidence, and TUI.
Installer VM smoke remains preflight-only until exact approval and SecurityExecutionEngine gates are satisfied.
Canary activation and rollback drill work must be executed or denied only through AgentCore PlanSpec plus SecurityExecutionEngine evidence.
RC8 keeps production_ready_claim=false until final audit proves every GA gate.
